findings.summary: Same-connection reauthorization only promotes the first 1,000 channel rows and cursors.
findings.details: commitReconcileChannels reads sourceChannels with .take(1_000) and derives promotedChannels from that truncated set. Same-connection reauthorization with more than 1,000 existing rows can leave later sourceChannels and their live/recent/deep/reconciliation channelSyncStates on the stale connectionGeneration, violating the S04-T02 contract that same-connection reauthorization preserves channel keys/cursors under the new generation. The focused tests cover two rows only and do not prove deterministic all-row draining.
